author: ChandooG
what_it_is: Save for CT, has 2 features, first is every extra unlocked, and i mean EVERY. Second, start a new game + with max stats for all characters (xcept magus)
format: DexDrive .gme: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header (per-block comments) + 131072-byte raw card; the card holds 2 save(s), 2 for this game (BASLUS-01363-00001, BASLUS-01363SYSTEM)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr final-fantasy-chronicles.4566.gme: unwraps the card (DexDrive .gme: 3904-byte header + card)

beetle-psx.detail: Slot 1's header reads NEW GAME +; block 1: The Final Battle
